findings.title: Dry runs can write through preserved symlinks
findings.description: `copyInstallPaths` preserves symlinks with `verbatimSymlinks: true`, then runs the installer against the sandbox. Installer writes through symlinked directories can therefore reach the original project or another location outside the sandbox, violating the guarantee that a dry run writes nothing. Add coverage for symlinked install paths and ensure the sandbox cannot follow links back to real destinations.

findings.title: Manifest paths can delete files outside the checkout
findings.description: `finish()` joins manifest-controlled paths to `targetRoot` and can unlink a stale file after its contents match the manifest, without checking lexical or real-path containment. A crafted manifest path such as `../...`, or a path through a symlinked directory, can target a matching file outside the checkout. The new setup-ide flow runs this installer directly on project and worktree roots; validate containment before reading or deleting stale paths.
